spans.s: ऋक्ष (I) m. 1. A bear; 2. the name of a mountain.
ऋक्ष (II) m.n. 1. A sign of the zodiac; 2. a lunar mansion.
ऋक्ष (III) m. pl. 1. The seven stars called the pleiades; 2. the seven Ṛshis.
ऋक्ष-चक्र n. the circle of stars.
ऋक्ष-नाथ m. an epithet of the moon.
ऋक्ष-राज्, -राज m. 1. Jāmbavat, the king of bears; 2. an epithet of the moon.
ऋक्ष-राज्, -राज m. 1. Jāmbavat, the king of bears; 2. an epithet of the moon.
ऋक्ष-वत् m. the name of a mountain near the Narmadā, वप्रक्रियामृक्षवतस्तटेषु R.v.44.
ऋक्षर m. 1. A thorn; 2. a priest.
ऋच्-संहिता f. the arranged collection of the hymns of the Ṛgveda.
